slides.headline: The order came. She can't let him *go*.
slides.sub: Frank Holl, Ordered to the Front, 1880

slides.headline: Highland soldiers get their *orders*. They leave today.
A soldier looks straight ahead. He can't show *fear*.
His wife holds his arm, pale and *frozen*.
Her hands grip his sleeve. She won't let *go*.
Beside them, a young mother holds her *baby* close.
One woman hides her face. She can't *bear* it.
Behind, his comrades wait in tall feather *bonnets*.
Kilt, white spats, polished shoes: ready to *march*.
Holl painted the families soldiers leave *behind*.
The order came. Would you let him *go*?
